items: The new branch has ____ parking spaces available for visitors.
'Parking spaces' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
There is ____ time left to revise the proposal before the deadline.
The manager made ____ adjustments to the schedule, so most appointments remain unchanged.
'Adjustments' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
We still have ____ flexibility in the delivery schedule, so a one-day delay is possible.
'Flexibility' is uncountable, so 'a little' is correct.
Very ____ applicants had prior experience with the specialized software.
'Applicants' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The equipment requires ____ maintenance during its first year of operation.
The audit identified ____ minor errors that can be corrected immediately.
'Errors' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
The technician needs ____ additional information before installing the update.
'Information' is uncountable, so 'a little' is correct.
Because ____ seats remain, late registrations may have to be declined.
'Seats' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The revised process leaves ____ room for manual data entry.
'Room' meaning available capacity is uncountable, so 'little' is correct.
The company received ____ complaints after the billing system was upgraded.
'Complaints' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
There is ____ demand for the product in smaller regional markets, but sales are beginning to rise.
'Demand' is uncountable, so 'a little' is correct.
____ employees volunteered for the weekend inventory count, so the supervisor requested extra help.
'Employees' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
The report provides ____ evidence that the new policy has reduced operating costs.
Only ____ suppliers can meet the revised packaging requirements.
'Suppliers' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
The budget includes ____ funding for staff training this quarter.
'Funding' is uncountable, so 'a little' is correct.
The remote office has ____ meeting rooms, which makes scheduling difficult.
'Meeting rooms' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
There was ____ interest in the optional workshop, so it was canceled.
The recruiter asked ____ follow-up questions before ending the interview.
'Questions' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
We have ____ experience with this vendor, but the initial results have been positive.
'Experience' is uncountable in this use, so 'a little' is correct.
The warehouse received ____ shipments during the holiday closure.
'Shipments' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The committee showed ____ enthusiasm for extending the trial period.
A technician found ____ loose connections inside the control panel.
'Connections' is countable plural, so 'a few' is correct.
The sales team has ____ knowledge of the new tax rules and will attend a briefing tomorrow.
'Knowledge' is uncountable, so 'a little' is correct.
____ customers used the express counter after 8 p.m., so the store shortened its hours.
'Customers' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
